question: Can the existing canonical native/companion seed descriptor produce bounded static MiniModel member-route configuration without payload copies or invented availability?
changes: Add bounded Buffer/stdin-only preparation with exact canonical descriptor validation and the current profiles, six-member order and native size limits.
Derive piece-set ID from exact descriptor bytes including final LF; output six immutable remote URLs, expected headers and hash-bound .htaccess text.
Use fixed application CORS origin, exposed identities, compression suppression requests, no-store/no-transform, method/name/query restrictions and actual-server content length.
No file writes, network requests, credentials, source snapshots, model copies, signing, metadata renewal or publication. Output publicationAllowed is always false.
Document actual host admission requirements and current publisher separation; do not weaken source, qualification or transport gates.

Current site publisher remains limited to its 22-file closure with unbound transport and expired catalog authority; new tool cannot publish.
Current descriptors are metadata only: graph closure, real bytes, licensing, numerical agreement and quality require their own existing evidence.
Remote directory colon support, actual directives, GET/HEAD/CORS and exact full-byte readback remain to be verified on the host.
No real model/default, live seed, independent outside acquisition or release success is claimed.
decision: Retain the tested generator as concrete static-host preparation. Require actual host behavior and qualification before constructing the seed publication route or advertising an exact composition.
lesson: Keep configuration compilation separate from host execution and qualification, but bind it to real producer bytes. Empty coverage suppression belongs on non-instrumented children, not the active experimental collector.
next: Execute the generated configuration against a controlled Apache/LiteSpeed host or the actual admitted hosting target; then connect exact verified payload streaming and remote readback to publication authority.
